title: Thread Folder URL Through ShoppingListDetailView
description: Add a folderURL stored property/init parameter to ShoppingListDetailView, use it for ShoppingListFiles read/write calls, and update delete/rename bracketing to use the bookmarked folder URL.
acceptance_criteria: The task load path calls ShoppingListFiles.readText with folderURL.
The save path calls ShoppingListFiles.writeText with folderURL.
deleteList brackets on folderURL instead of a derived shopping-lists folder URL.
renameList brackets on folderURL instead of a derived shopping-lists folder URL.
The ShoppingListDetailView preview passes a dummy folderURL.

handoff_summary.completed: All six acceptance criteria met: folderURL property added to ShoppingListDetailView; readText/writeText updated; deleteList/renameList use injected folderURL for security-scoped bracketing; preview passes dummy folderURL. Pre-existing compile failures from sibling beads fixed as build blockers (8 additional call sites across 5 files).
handoff_summary.risks: The pre-existing stale call sites spanned more files than expected from the B-45e92777 commit — tester should verify all shopping list and meal plan I/O flows exercise the correct folderURL path under access control.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to run the full test suite.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low — all changes are call-site updates to existing files; no new files or structural changes.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: renameList retains url.deletingLastPathComponent() (as listsFolderURL) for computing the new file destination — the file must stay in the shopping-lists subfolder. The injected folderURL is used only for security-scoped bracket, not for path computation. AddToShoppingListService.append gained a new folderURL: URL parameter to match the write signature; its caller (AddToShoppingListSheet) already had folderURL available.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: ShoppingListDetailViewTests instantiation tests updated with folderURL. Integration-level bracket correctness (actual file I/O under sandbox) requires tester agent with simulator.

conflict_risks: Low — all changes are call-site updates to existing files; no new files or structural changes.

execution_history.summary: Threaded folderURL through ShoppingListDetailView and fixed all pre-existing compile failures from the B-45e92777/B-54e5ddb5 signature updates. ShoppingListDetailView now stores folderURL explicitly and passes it to readText, writeText, deleteList, and renameList. All stale call sites across MealPlanDetailView, CreateShoppingListFromMealPlanService, AddToShoppingListService/Sheet, AddToMealPlanService/Sheet were also updated. Build passes clean.
